# Embedded browser libraries

This study vendors the existing compressed browser runtimes from the read-only
EulerAnnular report assets. Rendering decompresses and embeds them into the HTML;
the generated pages make no runtime network requests.

- Plotly.js 2.35.2: MIT license, preserved in `PLOTLY_LICENSE.txt`.
- MathJax 3.2.2 TeX/SVG bundle: Apache-2.0 license, preserved in
  `MATHJAX_LICENSE.txt`. The original bundle provenance is retained in
  `mathjax-source.json`.

The light/dark shell uses the same CSS theme variables and sans-serif visual
language as that repository report. Numerical data and solver code are separate
from these browser libraries.
